item.title: 'Never happened before': Parents react as illness closes Colton schools
item.description: Colton School District closed Monday due to a sharp spike in absenteeism caused by a fast-spreading illness, while Corbett School District reopened with normal attendance after a similar closure last week.

item.title: 'People over profits': Oregon reaches $17M settlement in drug price-fixing case
item.description: Oregon Attorney General Dan Rayfield announced on Monday the state reached a settlement with two pharmaceutical companies accused of inflating prices to limit competition.

item.title: Oregon man dies after hit-run on I-5
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (KOIN) -- A 34-year-old man died on Saturday after being struck on I-5 in Jackson County. The crash occurred at 7:20 a.m. near the exit 24 on-ramp. Officials say that a pedestrian, identified as Anthony Byam, had "been struck by a vehicle that did not stop." He was declared dead at the scene. [...]

item.description: Eugene has made national headlines after President Donald Trump called out the city on TruthSocial following a declared riot over the weekend.

item.description: Oregon's weather is beyond the grasp of a groundhog in Pennsylvania; in the Pacific Northwest, we only listen to beavers.

item.title: 'No justification': Portland City Councilors condemn federal use of tear gas at weekend protest
item.description: Portland's mayor and City Council have expressed outrage over the federal deployment of tear gas at a family-friendly event outside the ICE building, and are demanding quicker action to pass an ordinance to fine landlords who allow tenants to tear gas the neighborhood.

item.title: Son faces murder charge after mother found dead in Salem home
item.description: Salem police arrested a man on Monday in connection to the death of his 70-year-old mother, after two women were found dead under "suspicious circumstances" in late January.
